name: SpanishModelVariant456_HandleRequest
evidence: matching spanish_model_variant/variant456_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (two fans, two trails, two ribbons, sixteen lines, eight sheets and two streamers around the header-337 camera and part tracking); for a non-negative request it selects the 0x2C-byte command row at data + 0xFC indexed by the request and packs six texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and calls the sheet and spray helpers from the row's start frames; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the US and Japanese header-439 images build the same source through model_variant/variant439_entry.c, which selects CLUT x 512 instead of 640, and bind the helpers and data at their own addresses. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
